# Cycles survive GC; property names sort by UTF-16 code units.
builder
reserve a
reserve b
prim i integer
ucls ca open - n=A fwd=a
ucls cb open - n=B fwd=b
props a 😀:b,ｚ:i,z:i,é:a
props b back?:a,x:i
uarr arr in=list
items arr a
cls top list:arr n=Top
top Top top
finish printonrewrite
print
gc alpha
print
